title: Deodeok Flatbread Naan
description: A crispy flatbread infused with the sweetness of deodeok, perfect as a side dish for your next Indian meal. The combination of flavors and textures is a delightful twist on traditional naan.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet or tava over medium heat.
Divide the flatbread dough into 4 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a ball and then flatten it slightly into a disk shape.
Place a disk of dough into the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes or until it starts to puff up.
Flip the naan over and cook for another 1-2 minutes or until it's golden brown.
Brush the cooked naan with ghee or oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Repeat with the remaining dough pieces.
Once all the naan are cooked, place them on a serving plate and top with grated deodeok.
